summary: gather_facts runs the configured fact modules (setup by default), is called automatically by plays, and can be run ad hoc. Options must be supported by all fact modules, and merged facts favor the last merged module.
questions: How do I gather facts as a task instead of at play start?
Can I use multiple fact modules together?
Which value wins if two fact modules return the same fact?

answer_card.title: gather_facts module
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.gather_facts` runs the configured `FACTS_MODULES` (default `setup`). Plays call it automatically; you can run it ad hoc with `ansible -m gather_facts`.

Options must be supported by every configured fact module. Facts are merged with conflicts favoring the last merged; order isn't guaranteed when parallel.
